Subject: Bicycle Wheel Repairs on June 3

Hello riders,

Our June 3 repair cafe has volunteers ready to help with wobbly or damaged bicycle wheels. Whether you need a spoke tightened or a rim trued, we have tools on hand. Space at the workbench is limited, so please remember that everyone must book a slot beforehand to get wheel service.

Subject: Wheels added to our next fix-it session

Good news for local cyclists: our repair cafe will accept bicycle wheels on June 3. Volunteers can help inspect spokes, true rims, and troubleshoot worn hubs alongside our usual household fixes. Because workbench space is limited, everyone must book a slot in advance before bringing gear over.
